headline: Eight easy miles — now the foothills need a real week
body:
That was a 31-minute spin: 8.1 miles, 338 feet, 15.3 mph. It keeps the legs turning and nothing more, so both axes stand where they did. On distance you're respectable — 68.8 miles in your best week, a 27.7-mile longest ride — but 62 miles still needs a long ride in the 40s to feel routine. On climbing you're behind. Your biggest day is 1,819 feet, and Gibraltar alone is 2,551 in one 6.1-mile push after 30+ miles. Last week's 1,209 feet went the wrong direction with 33 days left.

This week, ride Tuesday and Wednesday short and easy — Wednesday carries a 19% rain chance, no reason to force it. Thursday and Friday are calm and mild, good for a foothill repeat day aimed at 2,000+ feet. Saturday and Sunday are dry with light wind: make one of them a 35–40 mile ride with the climbing built in, not tacked on.
